items.title: DuckDB 2.0.0 LTS “Cinnamon Teal”
items.blurb: The DuckDB team is happy to announce that today we're releasing DuckDB version 2.0.0 LTS, codenamed “Cinnamon Teal” (Spatula cyanoptera).

items.title: Article: AI Changes the Data Interface, Not the Query Engine
items.blurb: This article presents a disaster-recovery analytics workflow in which an AI agent generates constrained SQL or Python, DuckDB computes reproducible facts from Parquet, and the agent interprets the results.

items.title: 84% of surveyed Ruby on Rails developers run Postgres in production
items.blurb: 📌 Summary 84% of 1,800 surveyed Rails developers use PostgreSQL in production. While PostgreSQL is less popular than Oracle, MySQL, and Microsoft SQL Server today, the gap is shrinking.

items.title: How hstore Can Beat jsonb for Audit Logs
Why is Postgres's numeric Type So Slow?
items.blurb: Why is PostgreSQL’s numeric type slow? Andrei Lepikhov traces four design decisions behind its cost and compares DuckDB’s DECIMAL to see what exactness takes.

items.title: Citus Hits 10M QPS on Half Neki's Data Nodes
items.blurb: Open-source Citus delivers millions of queries per second more efficiently than Neki, the only other published data point at this scale

items.title: 118M QPS Neki post
items.blurb: We ran a massive, sharded Postgres database at 118.5 million queries per second, with 200k queries per second on each shard across 512 shards.
